description_en: Queries the tasks in the Waiting or Executing state on an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server实例中处于等待中和执行中的任务
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-tasks --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --start-time 2020-11-20T01:00Z --end-time 2020-11-20T02:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --status 2 --task-action CreateInstance --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTasks

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: **30 to 100**. Default value: **30**.
parameters.description_zh: 每页可展示的记录数，取值： **30~100**，默认值为**30**。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: **30 to 100**. Default value: **30**
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的记录数，取值： **30~100**，默认值为**30**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.
parameters.description_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**
